wiki.title: Jessica Giannino
wiki.extract: Jessica Ann Giannino is a State representative for Revere in the Massachusetts House of Representatives. She was elected to the Massachusetts house in 2020. She served as Revere city councilor at large since 2012. She graduated from Revere High School. Her district of 16th Suffolk includes Revere: Ward 1: Precinct 3, Ward 3, Ward 4, and Ward 6; Saugus: Precincts 3, 10 (Essex Co.)
